projects.name: Projects
projects.body: A folder per topic: its chats, files and instructions together.

meetings.body: Notes and action items from your calls, ready to ask about.

artifacts.name: Artifacts
artifacts.body: Documents, slides and small apps it built, kept to reopen.

scheduled.body: Tasks that run on their own, like a Monday brief.

proposal.name: Proposal for the Müller logistics lead

talking-points.description: A sales team in a logistics company, one project for its proposals. Left: where things live, projects, meetings, artifacts and scheduled tasks. Right: what every chat in the project starts with, instructions, memory and the context files; that is the freelancer's standing brief.
